note_en: This text keeps using 连…也/都 "even": 连周末都有人去自习室 "some people went to the study hall even on weekends." English just slips "even" in front of the surprising item, but Chinese frames that item with 连 and then must add 都 or 也 before the verb; leaving out 都/也 sounds unfinished.
